item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:20 HKT 27/Mar/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A fresh to strong easterly airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong today. It will be cloudier with temperatures falling slightly over the region. A southerly airstream is expected to bring hot weather to the coast of Guangdong in the latter part of this week and early next week. Meanwhile, under the influence of upper-air disturbances, the weather will be unsettled over southern China. There will be showers and thunderstorms.

Date/Month: 27/03 (Wednesday)

Weather: Mainly cloudy. One or two rain patches in the morning. Bright periods during the day.
Temp range: 21 - 25 C
